verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair thing to ask of it, but the evidence pack shows no public API or OpenAPI document. Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The MCP material covers Shortwave acting as an MCP client that connects to other servers, not a published API spec, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
